PART_DIPTUBE_PP.note: TRANSLUCENCY IS PAINTED, NOT SIMULATED: three's transmission buffer excludes transparent AND transmissive parts, so the tube must be opaque - and a translucent object READS as its background seen through milk. The PSD tube layer is near-white because the photo background is white; on OUR taupe stage the same tube reads milky-taupe #c9c0b4. Low env intensity kills the white rotation flare (Jordan). O2.8 curved thread per the product photos.
